title: Enrollment Windows and Linked-Product Terms of the Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan
content:
**Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan — enrollment and linked-product terms.** These terms are the same on all six tiers.

| Tier | Activation window (calendar days after enrollment) | Re-enrollment cooldown (calendar days after a plan closes) | Combined deduction ceiling (percent of the pay period's accrued net) | Transfers to the Paystride Visa Payroll Card require an active card account |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Paystride Access Starter | 30 | 30 | 50 percent | yes |
| Paystride Access Standard | 30 | 30 | 50 percent | yes |
| Paystride Access Plus | 30 | 30 | 50 percent | yes |
| Paystride Access Preferred | 30 | 30 | 50 percent | yes |
| Paystride Access Premier | 30 | 30 | 50 percent | yes |
| Paystride Access Premier Plus | 30 | 30 | 50 percent | yes |

## Definitions

- **Activation window** — the calendar days after enrollment within which employer verification must activate the plan.
- **Re-enrollment cooldown** — the calendar days after a plan closes before the worker may enroll again under the same employer program.
- **Combined deduction ceiling** — the percent of the pay period's accrued net that transfers plus a Paystride Payroll-Repaid Loan installment due the same payday may not exceed.
- **Active card requirement** — whether transfers to the Paystride Visa Payroll Card require that card account to be active.

**Hypothetical reading.** With a pay period's accrued net of 640.00 USD, 50 percent is 320.00 USD: the most that early wage transfers and a Paystride Payroll-Repaid Loan installment due that same payday may come to together under this term.
